evals.prompt:
A developer wants a pre-PR security review of this `git diff main..HEAD` patch before running `diff-scanning-with-aws-security-agent`. Identify every security vulnerability introduced in the diff, format the findings by severity (`CRITICAL`, `HIGH`, `MEDIUM`), and provide the remediated code:
```diff
diff --git a/app/api/export.py b/app/api/export.py
index 10a4b2c..8f91d3e 100644
--- a/app/api/export.py
+++ b/app/api/export.py
@@ -12,6 +12,15 @@ import subprocess
+import pickle
+import base64
+
+@app.post("/api/v1/export/custom")
+def run_custom_export(request):
+    filter_expr = request.json.get("filter", "")
+    session_blob = request.cookies.get("user_prefs")
+    prefs = pickle.loads(base64.b64decode(session_blob))
+    cmd = f"/usr/local/bin/export-tool --format csv --filter {filter_expr}"
+    out = subprocess.check_output(cmd, shell=True)
+    return Response(out, mimetype="text/csv")
```
evals.expected_output: Flags two `CRITICAL` vulnerabilities introduced in `app/api/export.py`: (1) Insecure Deserialization (`CWE-502` / RCE) via `pickle.loads(base64.b64decode(session_blob))` on an untrusted cookie, and (2) OS Command Injection (`CWE-78` / RCE) via `subprocess.check_output(cmd, shell=True)` with unvalidated `filter_expr`, and provides the remediated code using `json.loads` (with HMAC/JWT verification) and `subprocess.run(["/usr/local/bin/export-tool", "--format", "csv", "--filter", filter_expr], shell=False, check=True)`.
expectations: Flags `pickle.loads(base64.b64decode(session_blob))` on an untrusted HTTP cookie (`app/api/export.py`) as a `CRITICAL` Remote Code Execution / Insecure Deserialization vulnerability, replacing `pickle.loads` with safe `json.loads` (and signed cookies/session validation)

Flags `subprocess.check_output(cmd, shell=True)` interpolating `filter_expr` as a `CRITICAL` OS Command Injection vulnerability, replacing it with an argument list (`["/usr/local/bin/export-tool", "--format", "csv", "--filter", filter_expr]`) and `shell=False`
Provides the complete remediated `run_custom_export` implementation
